plain: An organized uprising against a government

webster.text: A rising against civil or political authority; the open and active opposition of a number of persons to the execution of law in a city or state.

more.text: A rising in mass to oppose an enemy.

example.quote: If, on the contrary, the insurrection should pervade a whole State, or a principal part of it, the employment of a different kind of force might become unavoidable.
